_about: The ONE mode table (docs/ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.md line 3, plan Phase 41.0, keystone K3). A mode is a property of the surface, never a user's choice. The privacy page's per-mode table, the OpenAPI text, the dashboard labels and the S3 encryption header text are generated from this file through internal/modes; a test fails when a name or sentence is typed anywhere else. A sentence marked requires_master_key is rendered only while the process has ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY loaded; otherwise its without_master_key text is. Vault is a tier, never a mode.

server_holds.text: Your files as ciphertext we cannot decrypt — the key arrives with each request and is never stored. We still see object names, sizes, counts, timestamps and when they are read.

customer.text: Only you hold the key: we store your files encrypted and cannot read them, and cannot recover them if the key is lost.

how.text: Every write into the bucket carries your own key (SSE-C), or your files are encrypted on your device before they are uploaded.

server_holds.text: Everything: your files, their names, sizes and metadata — we can read them.

customer.text: Encrypted at rest with keys we hold; we can read your files.
customer.without_master_key: Encrypted in transit. At rest your files sit on our storage providers' disks under the providers' own encryption, and we can read them.

how.text: The default for every bucket: nothing to set up.

server_holds.text: Everything, by design: anyone with the link can read it.

customer.text: Anyone with the link can download these files. They are not encrypted: they are meant to be read.

how.text: Make a bucket public from its settings in the dashboard; its files are served from our CDN.

developer.note: The S3 API, the management API and the SDK. Private through a bucket that requires SSE-C, or client-side encryption.

consumer.note: Recoverable (Standard) with Advanced protection (Private) as an opt-in until the passcode recovery vault exists (F-19); Private becomes the default the day it does.

public.note: Public buckets, share links and the content domain.
